test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Complete the statement given below with respect to the judge's removal.

The Indian Constitution :-

options.text: prescribes a procedure for removal of high court judges only.
prescribes a very difficult procedure for removal of judges.
does not prescribe a procedure for removal of judges.
prescribes a very flexible procedure for removal of judges.

solution:
The correct answer is __**prescribes a very difficult procedure for removal of judges**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Constitution **prescribes a very difficult procedure for removal of judges**.
 
• The process for removal of judges is outlined in **Article 124(4) and Article 217(1)(b)** of the Constitution.
 
• The removal process involves a motion being passed by a special majority in both houses of Parliament on grounds of proven misbehavior or incapacity.
 
• This stringent procedure ensures judicial independence and protects judges from arbitrary removal.
 
• The process is designed to be exhaustive to maintain the integrity and impartiality of the judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The removal of a judge is a rare and serious event, reflecting the high standards of accountability for the judiciary in India.
 
• The procedure for removal of judges is a critical component of the checks and balances within the Indian democratic framework.
